description: Confirm or cancel the member's or a linked child's RSVP for one class; this can move the waitlist. Never without the user's confirmation. Returns the authoritative status and any waitlist position.

branch_id.description: Club UUID from the member's list_my_subjects result; access is checked for this club.
branch_id.title: Branch Id

child_id.description: Optional linked child's subject_id from list_my_subjects; omit for the signed-in member.
child_id.title: Child Id

occurrence_key.description: Exact class occurrence key returned by the public or member class schedule.
occurrence_key.title: Occurrence Key

status.description: Requested RSVP: attending or cancelled. Call only after the user confirms.
status.title: Status

name: set_class_rsvp
title: Change a class RSVP
